item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Trump warns 'clock is ticking' for Iran as peace progress stalls
item.description: On Monday Iran said it had responded to the latest US proposal and that exchanges with Washington were continuing.

item.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
item.description: The US president says he is holding off on a US attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".

item.title: Trump administration unveils $1.7bn fund to compensate his allies as he drops tax lawsuit
item.description: The settlement will go towards individuals who allege they were subjected to unfair investigations.
